# CodeRa
> Chrome extension that extracts formatted code from video frames (YouTube, Udemy, Coursera) and screenshots using AI vision, preserving indentation. Free, no sign-up. Flagship: collect whole lesson → project pack + local library + exports.

## Product facts
- Modes: plain text, extract as code, understand code
- Capture: Alt+C, floating button, select area, lesson collection while watching
- Local snippet library with filters and GitLab Snippets publish
- Exports: Obsidian, Notion Markdown, Anki
- AI: Anthropic API (see Privacy); optional own API key
- Author: Anton Zakharenka
